Fixed-width binning grouper

Source: R/clustering.R
bin_grouper.Rd

Group id is floor(mz / bin_width) + 1. Fast, but two close values on either side of a bin edge end up in different groups. Uses only mz.

Usage

bin_grouper(bin_width = 0.01)

Arguments

bin_width

Bin width in Da.

Value

A grouper closure - see grouper-contract.

Examples

g <- bin_grouper(bin_width = 0.01)
g(c(100.001, 100.009, 100.015))
#> [1] 10001 10001 10002
